items.question: Do I need to pay a deposit to book?
items.answer: No. You can book without any credit card or deposit. Payment is made after your trip is completed.

items.question: Are there any hidden fees?
items.answer: None. The listed price already includes the driver, fuel, and taxes. Entrance tickets and meals are usually separate and explained on each package page.

items.question: How far in advance should I book?
items.answer: During peak season (July–August, December–January) we recommend booking at least 3-5 days ahead. Outside peak season, booking a day before is usually fine.

items.question: Can I create my own itinerary?
items.answer: Yes. Besides our set packages, we also offer car rental with driver so you can build your own flexible route.

aboutPage.label: About Us
aboutPage.title: Years of showing travelers a side of Bali they wouldn't find on their own
aboutPage.paragraph1: PT. Cahaya Dimbo Abadi is a licensed tour operator based in Gianyar, Bali. We started as a small car rental with driver service, and have grown into a trusted provider of tour packages, transport, and activities for thousands of travelers from around the world.
aboutPage.paragraph2: We believe the best travel experience comes from openness: clear pricing from the start, drivers who truly know Bali's culture and terrain, and service you can pay for after your trip — not before you're sure.
aboutPage.paragraph3: When needed, we also work with licensed tour guides who have deep knowledge of Bali's history and art, so every story you hear along the way is accurate and meaningful.
